{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Straight-leg trousers, ankle length, dark charcoal #3A3D42, wool-blend crepe with a slight texture

Fitted turtleneck, hip length, deep burgundy #6B2737, fine merino wool

Single-breasted trench coat, knee length, belted, khaki beige #B59B76, water-repellent cotton gabardine

Ankle boots, low block heel, almost flat, chocolate brown #4A3328, water-protected suede

Compact umbrella, automatic, matte black #1C1C1E, windproof nylon

Crossbody bag, medium size, dark brown #3B2A20, grained leather

Thin scarf, wide, warm taupe #8C7B6B, soft wool-silk blend

Why this outfit works: The suede boots you wanted sit at the centre of the look, and a water-protective finish plus a low block heel keep them comfortable and safe for a rainy walk to the office. The trousers and the fine merino turtleneck give a neat, office-appropriate base that stays warm without bulk. The belted trench in water-repellent cotton shields you from the autumn rain, and the crossbody bag keeps your hands free for the umbrella. The palette of charcoal, burgundy, khaki and chocolate brown is rich and harmonious, so everything looks polished all day."}
